title: A container destroyed mid-turn cannot restore on staging: no origin
description:
The staging stand-in seeds its bare origin (/srv/origin.git) INSIDE the container (cloudflare/staging/agent.Dockerfile --boot), and the attempt's WorkspaceGit.remote is that path (harness/src/host/worker-attempt.ts workspaceGit). A destroyed container therefore boots a fresh box with no origin at all: the restore's git fetch fails, and jhp's planned mid-turn destroy proof on staging cannot exercise the restore it exists for. tick cni's proof emptied the workspace instead (same restore code, same setup line), but epic 43y's [A2] asks for the destroy proven on staging. The stand-in needs an origin that outlives the box: a container volume on /srv, or an origin the container reaches over the network.
evidence: cloudflare/staging/agent.Dockerfile --boot (git init --bare /srv/origin.git inside the image's container); harness/src/host/worker-attempt.ts:764 workspaceGit (remote: spec.repoUrl)
